title: Wings live: Odeon, Leicester | 1973
content:
Wings performed at the Odeon in Leicester, England, on 9 July 1973.

It was the 17th and penultimate night of the 18-date Wings 1973 UK Tour, which opened on 11 May in Bristol. The support act was Brinsley Schwarz. Tickets cost 60p, 80p, £1, £1.30, and £1.60.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Henry McCullough on guitar and vocals; and Denny Seiwell on drums.
